purpose compound indicating the aim of the recitation
name of the mantra or deity forming the first member of the series
qualifies mantrān as those starting with mṛtyuñjaya and others like it

items.question: Which mantras must be recited to secure one's own protection?
premises: The practitioner is the agent enjoined to recite.
The recitation is undertaken for the purpose of self-protection.
The objects of recitation are mantras beginning with Mṛtyuñjaya.
items.inference: Therefore, for self-protection the practitioner should recite mantras beginning with the Mṛtyuñjaya mantra.
uncertainties: The specific additional mantras included by ādikān are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: He should recite mantras beginning with the Mṛtyuñjaya for the sake of self-protection.
